entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I think it's... it's not working right. I'm just so confused by this whole thing.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're having trouble. I can definitely look into this for you. To get started, could I get your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Yes, it's Arthur Penhaligon, and the email is arthur.p@email.com.
Thank you, Arthur. I'm pulling up your account now... I see you purchased the VeloBand GPS Tracker. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, um, a technical fault, I guess? The main reason I got it was for the pulse tracking, and that part seems broken. It just won't sync my heart rate correctly. It's really frustrating. The device seems defective.

I understand. So the pulse monitor is not working as you expected and you feel the unit might be defective. Let me see what we can do. I see here that the item was delivered to you 19 days ago, is that correct?
Yes, that sounds about right. I'm just so overwhelmed. I didn't understand the policy on the website. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Arthur. It's no problem at all. Let me just check our return policy for you... one moment.
Okay, I've got it here. Our knowledge base says that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
That's right. Since you received it only 19 days ago, you are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and process a full return for you right now, no questions asked.
Really? You can do that? I thought it was going to be a whole big process. That's... that's such a relief!

Absolutely. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file, arthur.p@email.com. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed.
Wow. Thank you so much, Diana. You've been a huge help. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome, Arthur. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
Have a wonderful day. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
